title: Desenvolvedor Python
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor Backend Python Sênior

Atuação: 100% home office


Buscamos por um Desenvolvedor Backend para atuar em um projeto de midware de IA, focado em aplicações que consomem e expõem modelos LLM, garantindo arquitetura moderna, boas práticas de código e integração com o ecossistema de produtos do cliente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e evoluir aplicações backend utilizando Python e FastAPI
  • Aplicar arquitetura de microsserviços em soluções de backend
  • Colaborar na definição e evolução de padrões de arquitetura e código
  • Integrar aplicações com serviços de mensageria, bancos de dados relacionais e ambiente cloud
  • Garantir qualidade por meio de testes unitários, monitoração e observabilidade
  • Atuar em conjunto com times de produto e dados na construção de soluções que utilizam LLM e IA generativa


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Python
  • FastAPI
  • Conhecimento em LLM e conceitos de IA generativa
  • Programação orientada a objetos
  • Conhecimento em padrões de arquitetura
  • Conhecimento em padrões de código
  • Experiência com serviços de mensageria como Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ ou Kafka
  • Banco de dados relacional PostgreSQL
  • Vivência em ambiente Azure ou similar
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • Arquitetura de microsserviços
  • Testes unitários
  • GitFlow
  • Sonar
  • Datadog


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prática em projetos com IA generativa, RAG ou NLP
  • Atuação prévia em produtos digitais de grande escala
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis e times multidisciplinares


Se você gosta de desafios e quer trabalhar com IA em produtos de grande impacto, essa pode ser a sua oportunidade.

title: Python Developer
description:
Building a risk applications and tools for innovative international top-tier hedge fund from the ground up, comprising the systems for traders, pre-trade checks and analysis, risks and limits management, reports of trading activities, FIX connectivity, market data providers connectivity (e.g. Bloomberg B-pipe), etc


Responsibilities:

  • The Team is focused on the development and maintenance of various applications. The successful candidate will have considerable and proven experience in Python, a good working knowledge of end-user and server-side data processing techniques, a good understanding of SDLC and agile development methodologies.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • Strong understanding of data quality principles
  • - Hands-on exp with Python
  • - at least 1 year of experience in trading domain/capital markets
  • - Proven experience in designing and developing data models using industry best practices
  • - Experience in using code management and CI/CD tools such as Github, Azure Devops, Jenkins, Bamboo etc.
  • - 5+ years of experience working with Python
  • - Good understanding and demonstrated experience working with SQL (MySQL).
  • - Extensive experience designing and developing reports and performance metrics from complex and disparate platforms
  • - Experience in using code management and CI/CD tools such as Github, Azure Devops, Jenkins, Bamboo etc.
  • - 5+ years of experience working with Python
  • - Good understanding and demonstrated experience working with Power Query (M query language) and DAX.
  • - Extensive experience designing and developing reports and performance metrics from complex and disparate platforms


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Risks trading system development experience.
  • - Python web frameworks such has Django and FastAPI.
  • - Understanding and demonstrated experience working with MySQL. Experience in using code management and CI/CD tools such as Github, Azure Devops, Jenkins, Bamboo etc.
  • - Geneva experience especially in gSQL and RSL.
  • - KDB Experience


Languages:

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Gerente de Vendas
description:
A Zoomlion Brasil, multinacional com forte atuação global nos segmentos de máquinas pesadas, está com processo seletivo aberto para a posição de Gerente de Vendas no Brasil.


Esta é uma oportunidade estratégica para profissionais com sólida experiência no setor, perfil de liderança e visão comercial orientada a resultados.


Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar a equipe nacional de vendas, promovendo o desenvolvimento comercial dos profissionais;
  • Definir estratégias comerciais alinhadas ao posicionamento global da empresa e às demandas do mercado brasileiro;
  • Gerenciar metas, indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e relatórios de performance;
  • Identificar oportunidades de expansão de mercado e novos canais de distribuição;
  • Atuar diretamente na negociação com grandes contas e parceiros estratégicos;
  • Representar a empresa em feiras, eventos e visitas institucionais, mantendo relacionamento próximo com clientes e stakeholders.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Ensino superior completo (Administração, Engenharia, ou áreas correlatas);
  • Inglês avançado (interações frequentes com a matriz e equipes globais);
  • Experiência comprovada na função de gerência comercial em empresas do segmento de máquinas pesadas;
  • Histórico de liderança de equipes comerciais e gestão de territórios nacionais;
  • Conhecimento do mercado brasileiro, canais de distribuição e estratégias de penetração comercial.

title: Assistente de Design
description:
Sobre o Grupo EWZ:

Somos um grupo de soluções financeiras em constante crescimento. Composto pelas marcas EWZ Capital, Mundo Invest e Ilha Forte, acreditamos no poder da inovação, da excelência e do design estratégico para gerar resultados. Agora, buscamos um(a) novo(a) Assistente de Design para reforçar nosso time criativo.


O que você irá fazer:

• Criar criativos para anúncios (meta ads, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, etc.), garantindo consistência com o posicionamento visual das marcas (EWZ Capital, Ilha Fort e Mundo Invest).

• Desenvolver peças institucionais internas (apresentações, relatórios, templates e comunicações internas).

• Cuidar da identidade visual digital , garantindo coesão entre site, landing pages e campanhas.

• Apoiar o time de marketing e tecnologia na experiência do usuário (UX) e interface (UI) dos sites e sistemas internos.

• Adaptar conteúdos para diferentes canais (social, e-mail, web) com foco em performance e conversão.

• Manter uma biblioteca organizada de assets, templates e guidelines visuais.

• Acompanhar métricas de desempenho dos criativos (CTR, CPC, conversão) em conjunto com o time de mídia.


O que esperamos de você:

• Formação (concluída ou em andamento) em Design Gráfico, Publicidade ou áreas correlatas.

• Domínio de Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator).

• Conhecimento em Figma (obrigatório).

• Organização, atenção aos detalhes e boa comunicação.

• Perfil criativo, curioso, proativo e colaborativo.


Diferenciais:

• Vivência com criação para tráfego pago e redes sociais .

• Experiência prévia no mercado financeiro.

• Experiência básica em projetos de UX/UI (wireframes, protótipos, landing pages).

• Familiaridade com criação orientada a dados e KPIs de performance.


Vaga 100% presencial em Pinheiros, São Paulo.


Se você se identifica com esse perfil e quer crescer em um time dinâmico e inovador, essa vaga é pra você!

title: Desenvolvedor .Net Sênior (Inglês Fluente)
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor(a) .NET Sênior — Inglês Fluente


Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) .NET Sênior para atuar em um projeto internacional em uma empresa global que atua com consultoria estratégica, modernização de processos e soluções digitais corporativas.


❗ A atuação é focada no desenvolvimento de aplicações web robustas e escaláveis, trabalhando com tecnologias modernas em um ambiente colaborativo e multicultural.


✨ Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando .NET (C#) e MVC .
  • Criar interfaces dinâmicas e responsivas usando Angular .
  • Projetar, implementar e ajustar APIs RESTful para integração entre sistemas.
  • Realizar consultas, otimizações e manutenções em MySQL .
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para compreensão de requisitos e entrega de soluções de alta qualidade.
  • Participar de revisões de código e contribuir com melhorias contínuas nos processos de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida com .NET (C#) e MVC .
  • Forte domínio em Angular para desenvolvimento front-end.
  • Experiência com MySQL e criação/otimização de queries SQL.
  • Vivência com desenvolvimento e manutenção de APIs RESTful .
  • Inglês fluente , com capacidade de comunicação com equipes globais e leitura de documentação técnica.


Contratação

  • Modelo contractor via Deel (PJ)
  • Projeto internacional, com interação constante com times de outros países (inglês fluente obrigatório).

title: Data Enginner w/ Databricks  (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 4 years of professional experience as a Data Engineer;
  • At least 3 years of professional experience with Databricks and Python;
  • Fluent in both spoken and written English - (B2 or above - Mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase?

We are waiting for you!


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Business Developer PtX
description:
Leap29 are partnering with a leading international Independent Power Producer (IPP) entering Brazil’s renewable energy market. They are seeking a Business Developer to drive growth in Power-to-X (PtX) and green hydrogen projects. This is a remote role, but candidates must have a strong understanding of the Brazilian market, with established networks and local expertise to identify and develop new opportunities.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct market, regulatory, and economic research to identify viable PtX and green hydrogen opportunities in Brazil.
  • Evaluate potential projects, sites, and partners during the screening phase.
  • Support early-stage project risk assessment and feasibility analysis.
  • Develop preliminary financial forecasts and investment models to guide strategic decisions.
  • Collaborate with internal and external teams to assess alignment with company goals.
  • Leverage existing networks to gather market intelligence and insights.


Key Requirements:

  • Proven experience in business development for PtX, green hydrogen or related derivatives.
  • Good knowledge of PtX, green hydrogen, and renewable energy markets in Brazil.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain relationships with local stakeholders in Brazil.
  • Ability to evaluate opportunities and conduct early-stage project analysis.
  • Strategic thinker with a proactive approach to identifying business opportunities.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish would be a plus)
  • Able to work remotely from Brazil, with occasional travel as needed.


Join a leading European IPP expanding into Brazil’s green hydrogen and PtX market. Leverage your local expertise, work with an international team, and help shape the future of renewable energy.


Ready to take on the challenge? Apply today!

title: Desenvolvedor Pleno (GIS)
description:
Analisar, planejar e executar desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Formação:

  • Graduado.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Experiência trabalhando com serviços restfull e microserviços;
  • Conhecimentos em html5, CSS3, node.js, angular, vue e react;
  • Conhecimentos em Python;
  • Conhecimentos em SQL e Análise de Dados;
  • Experiência em levantar e documentar requisitos juntos aos usuários;
  • Capacidade de realizar testes unitários e de integração;
  • Capacidade de desenvolvimento de soluções utilizando todas as linguagens suportadas na plataforma ArcGIS.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Vivência em metodologias ágeis;
  • Conhecimentos na plataforma ArcGIS;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.


Responsabilidades:

  • Escrever códigos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas seguindo padrões de nomenclatura e práticas da empresa;
  • Detalhar projetos, determinando suas interfaces, limites de automação e plataforma tecnológica;
  • Construir modelos funcionais e de dados de sistemas, aplicando boas práticas que garantam visão estruturada, qualidade, reutilização, facilidade de manutenção de códigos;
  • Identificar, avaliar e definir frameworks, componentes e softwares para desenvolvimento, através da conceituação, documentação e experimentação, buscando aprimorar as soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Realizar avaliações de segurança e performance de soluções;
  • Aplicar e avaliar testes funcionais e não funcionais, seguindo o plano de testes estabelecido, junto ao cliente visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Escrever o plano de testes funcionais e não funcionais visando a entrega da solução e satisfação do cliente;
  • Avaliar e elaborar a documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos e os repositórios de informação dos projetos;
  • Assegurar as interfaces de integração com outras plataformas/soluções.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?

Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Kotlin Senior
description:
Na Jaya Tech , acreditamos na Engenharia de Software Consciente , uma abordagem inovadora, e por isso oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho inspirador, focado em promover o autoconhecimento, tomar decisões embasadas em dados, cultivar relacionamentos saudáveis e entender o impacto do nosso trabalho. Aqui, você encontrará oportunidades para crescimento profissional e pessoal, contribuindo para projetos que têm um impacto significativo na indústria e na sociedade.


Sobre o Projeto

Você fará parte de um time em uma empresa inovadora, especializada em desenvolver soluções para o seguimento financeiro contribuindo para a transformação digital desse setor.


Atuação 100% remota | Forma de contratação: CLT | Reuneração: Real| Full-time


Requisitos Necessários


• Linguagens orientadas a objeto e sem restrições para trabalhar com Java e Kotlin

• Arquitetura de Microserviços

• Boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software – TDD, DDD, Clean Code e

• Arquitetura Hexagonal

• Práticas/Frameworks ágeis: SCRUM ou KANBAN

• Banco de Dados SQL

• Protocolo HTTP/HTTPS

• GIT / Git Flow

• Boa comunicação e parceria com o time


Desejável:


• Spring boot e/ou Javalin

• noSQL

• Docker e Kubernetes

• Experiência com solução de streaming de dados

• Experiência com solução orientada a eventos

• Plataformas ApiGee e NodeJs (gerenciamento server-side, gerenciamento de

APIs)

• AWS

Rotina de Trabalho da Squad:

• preocupação com o produto desenvolvido, em todo seu ciclo de vida (desde a

concepção da funcionalidade, acompanhamento de testes, deploy em produção,

sustentação e melhoria contínua)

• Disponibilização de serviços vinculados ao produto

• Solucionar problemas técnicos (bugs/incidentes/análises)

• Seguir políticas e processos definidos pelo cliente

• Codificar testes unitários, funcionais, performance, seguindo

diretrizes/orientações do time

• Instrumentar as aplicações para extração de informações de performance,

logs de funcionamento e métricas.

title: Cloud Platform Developer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home


Job Summary

We seek an experienced high-performing Python engineer for a position supporting and developing new tools and processes to be used on an on-prem private cloud application. Your role will involve to communicate technical concepts clearly, facilitate discussions, collaborate with stakeholders, provide project updates and mentor team members.


Responsibilities and Duties

  • Develop high performance cloud and container technologies mostly leveraging Python as the main programming language;
  • Develop and deliver high quality solutions and code;
  • Develop unit tests, improving the SDLC;
  • Investigate and resolve issues reported during testing and customer integration;
  • Actively participate in all aspects of an agile software development process;
  • Work as part of a team focused on containerization, virtualization and fault tolerant/carrier grade development;
  • Contribute to a highly available orchestration platform used to deploy private cloud platform aimed to be at the core of 5G and distributed Edge deployments worldwide.


Essential Skills

  • Solid backend developer (preferably but not restricted to Python), knowledgeable in Linux Essentials:
  • Medium knowledge in concepts of hardware, processes, programs and the components of the Linux Operating System;
  • How to work on the command line and with files;
  • How to create and restore compressed backups and archives;
  • System security: users/groups and file permissions for public and private directories;
  • How to create and run simple scripts;
  • Interested in working on development and troubleshooting of a highly distributed orchestration platform supporting multiple vendors;
  • Strong computer networking knowledge and transport (TCP/UDP/etc.) layers;
  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts;
  • Experience collaborating effectively across remote teams and time zones, and collaborating with Senior Technical Leaders;
  • Experience with GIT, Jira, Gitlab and code review tools;
  • Experience with container technologies (e.g., Docker, Linux Containers, etc.);
  • Experience with Kubernetes Cluster Administration (design infrastructure that involves one or more Kubernetes clusters, configure, control, and monitor Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with Docker;
  • Experience with Helm.


Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Kubernetes App Development (design and development of applications that run in Kubernetes clusters);
  • Experience with PostgreSQL as a developer;
  • Experience with RabbitMQ as a developer.


About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Analista de Operações de Transportadoras Sênior
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?


Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Analista de Operações de Transportadoras Sênior que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Operações e que queira crescer com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Manter relacionamento com as transportadoras, monitorando indicadores de desempenho e padrões de qualidade.
  • Mapear gargalos operacionais e propor ações.
  • Revisar e implementar processos visando escalabilidade.

title: Analista de Dados Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Coletar e limpar dados, identificando fontes relevantes e tratando valores ausentes e outliers;
  • Aplicar conceitos e ferramentas de digital analytics: GA4, firebase, GTM, Big Query;
  • Desenvolver dashboards, queries, algorítmos para monitorar e melhorar a performance dos processos;
  • Ser propritário de sua frente de negócio, planejando e priorizando as atividades de acordo com as necessidades de negócio e do valor de suas entregas para Allos;
  • Traduzir problemas de negócios em termos analíticos e facilitar tomadas de decisão para resolução destes problemas;
  • Propor pró-ativamente soluções técnicas e de negócio;
  • Ser pró-ativo na garantia de segurança e privacidade dos dados, cumprindo regulamentações.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em tecnologia, ciências exatas/biológicas com foco em tecnologia ou experiência comprovada na área de banco de dados;
  • Experiência em Data Analytics, Big Query/Databricks;
  • Conhecimento Avançado em análise de dados e estatística intermediário (Amostragem, Teste de Hipótese, Inferência).
  • SQL (DQL, DDL) Avançado.;
  • Conhecimento Intermediário linguagens como JavaScript, Python ou R. Experiencia em extração de dados, ingestão e transformação;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Tableau, Power BI).


Nossos benefícios:


  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
  • Vale Transporte/Estacionamento;
  • Plano de Saúde;
  • Plano Odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • WellHurb;
  • Auxílio Farmácia;
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Acolhe (serviço de apoio psicossocial);
  • Saber Online (plataforma interna de aprendizagem);
  • Bônus Anual

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Engenharia de Dados AWS Pleno/Sênior - ID 123360
description:
Sobre a vaga


Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID


Requisitos:

Linguagem de Programação: Python, SQL, Scala, Pyspark, Shell Script. Fundamentos: DataMesh, Database SQL e NoSQL, Hadoop Ecossistema, Engenharia de Software, Privacidade e Segurança. Engenharia de Dados: Data Ingestion, Data Stream, PRocessamento Paralelo, Processamento Massivo. Arquitetura de Dados: ETL vs ELT, Modelagem tradicional, Dimensional e Hibrido, Estruturado / Não Estruturado, Camada de Dados Brutos (SOR), Camada de Dados Harmonizados (SOT), Camada de Dados Especializados (SPEC), Data Analytics, Data Viz, Data Storytelling. Experiencia com processamento distribuído e de grandes volumes de dados. Vivência em Pipelines CI/CD (codepipeline / githubactions); Conhecimento nos serviços primários da AWS (Storage Gateway, Direct Connect, DMS, Lambda, Glue, RDS, API Gateway)


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:


Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.


Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Azure Cloud Engineer with Bicep
description:
Azure Cloud Engineer with Bicep

Location: Remote (EST Hours)

Contract Duration: 12 months (with possible extension for ongoing needs)


Experience required

Must have 10/10 communication and ability to articulate well.

Azure infrastructure.

*************************Automation via BICEP


Overview:

We are seeking a Cloud Engineer with strong expertise in Azure to support our evolving cloud infrastructure needs following a recent organizational restructure. These roles will help address increased workloads and support cross-functional initiatives within our application and data teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the development, optimization, and automation of Azure-based cloud solutions.
  • Work within a Scaled Agile Framework (SaFE), actively participating in backlog grooming and refinement sessions.
  • Provide technical input and recommendations to improve existing backlog items and identify gaps.
  • Collaborate with application and data teams to ensure infrastructure and network solutions meet project requirements.
  • Support and optimize services within an Application Service Environment (ASE).
  • Configure and manage Private Endpoints and Azure Private Link for secure access.
  • Assist with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) implementation using tools like ARM, Bicep, or Terraform.
  • Troubleshoot network configurations and support secure connectivity between services.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • 3–5 years of hands-on experience with Azure cloud services.
  • Proficiency in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Databricks, and automation tools.
  • Solid understanding of Infrastructure as Code principles and scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Bicep, Terraform).
  • Experience with Private Endpoints, Private Link, and ASE configuration.
  • Basic networking knowledge (VNet, NSGs, routing).
  • Experience working within a SaFE Agile environment and contributing to backlogs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

title: Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor Role
description:
Head of Product Design (UI/UX, AI-Forward) - Contractor


Downstream · Open to employees in Argentina, Bolivia, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Paraguay, Peru, Suriname, Uruguay, Venezuela


About Downstream


Downstream is transforming the construction industry by building a marketplace for equipment rentals, portable toilets, and roll-off dumpsters. We are scaling fast. Our vision: bring price transparency, automation, and intelligence into one of the most manual, underserved verticals in the economy.


We’re inspired by clean design and modern architecture—and we’re pushing forward with AI-native product thinking, not bolting it on later.


The Role


We’re hiring a Head of Product Design (UI/UX) who is obsessed with creating intuitive, elegant, and impactful user experiences. You’ve shipped something before—whether at a startup that scaled, a product that users loved, or a platform that redefined a workflow. You know the pain of turning complex problems into simple, usable solutions, and you want another shot at shaping an industry from 0 → 1.


At Downstream, you’ll work directly with our CEO, CTO, and Product team to:

  • Define and own the design vision for our marketplace, supplier tools, and customer experience.
  • Lead end-to-end design for web and mobile, including UX flows, UI systems, and visual identity.
  • Architect AI-native product experiences that feel intuitive, not artificial—helping users trust automation and agents in critical workflows.
  • Collaborate with engineers and product managers to ship fast: prototype, test, iterate, and refine.
  • Build and scale our design system so we can move quickly without sacrificing quality.


Responsibilities

  • Drive the product design strategy across customer, supplier, and internal platforms.
  • Build and maintain UI/UX standards that reflect simplicity, trust, and efficiency.
  • Design AI-native experiences—where agentic systems interact seamlessly with users, data, and decisions.
  • Conduct user research and usability testing with construction industry stakeholders.
  • Mentor and grow a design team as we scale.


What We’re Looking For

  • Battle-tested designer: You’ve shipped real products (startup, marketplace, SaaS, or similar).
  • AI-forward mindset: You don’t just add AI—you design around it, making it feel natural and empowering.
  • Builder’s DNA: Comfortable with ambiguity, speed, and iteration. You’ve felt the pain of building in the real world and still want more.
  • Technical & design skills:
  • UI/UX design (Figma, Sketch, or equivalent)
  • Strong UX research and prototyping chops
  • Design systems and component libraries
  • Understanding of modern frontend frameworks (bonus: Flutter, React)
  • Experience designing for AI interactions (chat, agents, workflows)
  • Startup mentality: Hands-on, resourceful, willing to go beyond your job title.
  • Industry experience: Construction tech or marketplaces a huge plus—someone who can empathize with our users.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in marketplaces, logistics, SaaS, or fintech.
  • Familiarity with B2B workflows and procurement tools.
  • Contributions to open-source design systems or AI products.


Why Downstream

  • Early-stage, high-growth startup with real traction.
  • Work with a small, sharp, and ambitious product + engineering team.
  • Opportunity to shape AI-native product experiences in an industry that hasn’t seen this level of innovation before.
  • Competitive salary + equity

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description:
About Artisan

At Artisan, we’re building real AI employees - not copilots, not assistants, but autonomous teammates.


Our first, Ava, is an AI BDR. She finds and researches leads, writes emails in customers’ tone of voice, runs outbound sequences, self-optimizes, and manages email deliverability infrastructure. She learns, adapts, and improves over time - just like a human would.


Human team members use Artisan as their primary working platform, replacing a sprawling stack of sales tools, and have Artisans working alongside them.


We went through Y Combinator (W24) and have raised $35M+ from top investors. We’re at $7M+ ARR, with hundreds of customers including Remote, Quora, and SumUp. We’re currently working on Ava 2.0, pushing the boundaries of what an AI employee can do. And we're hiring.


Your Mission

You’ll design, build, and scale the backend that powers AI employees while following our principles:

  • Velocity is Everything:  keep the 20/80 rule in mind, delay kills growth
  • Think Like a Founder:  ship with quality, have strong opinions, and speak up if you disagree
  • Operate With Efficiency:  put the customer first, write it down, and use AI wherever possible
  • Communication Rules Everything:  be clear and concise, give candid, unsolicited feedback
  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful:  don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value; Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter:  have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant:  At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy:  You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
  • Culture:  Have a chat with our teammates, each and everyone has a clear reason about why they love it.

  • Meetings, But Make Them Useful:  don’t attend meetings where you don’t add or extract value; Presence ≠ productivity
  • Vibes Matter:  have a positive attitude, make others feel appreciated, we’re here to win


What You Bring

  • 6+ years of backend engineering experience in high-growth environments, preferably early-stage or Series B.
  • Strong experience building scalable, data-intensive services with modern APIs and robust infrastructure.
  • Proficiency with AWS and GitHub Actions.
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, reliability, performance, and database systems (SQL + NoSQL).
  • Experience with modern stacks - TypeScript/Node preferred, but equivalent backend stacks are welcome.
  • Demonstrated track record of ownership - leading parts of systems independently and shipping with impact.
  • Excellent communication, clarity in articulating architecture to technical and non-technical stakeholders.


What Makes This Role Stand Out

  • Stay relevant:  At Artisan we are creating AI employees and you'll learn how to not be replaced by one.
  • Ownership and autonomy:  You'll be given trust, and expected excellence.
  • Compensation:  Real equity upside and compensation aligned with high expectations and high impact.
  • Culture:  Have a chat with our teammates, each and everyone has a clear reason about why they love it.

title: Cientista de Dados sênior (Exp. com detecção de fraude)
description:
Somos a maior multinacional brasileira e estamos entre as 100 maiores empresas de TI do mundo. Estamos presentes em 41 países com mais de 30 mil colaboradores. A Stefanini tem como principal objetivo auxiliar os clientes a encontrar, por meio de soluções personalizadas, a maneira ideal para alcançar seus desafios, impulsionando a inovação digital. E queremos mais!


  • Atuação 100% remoto.


Responsabilidades:

  • Construir, validar e publicar modelos de machine learning voltados para detecção de fraudes , sistemas de recomendação ou outras aplicações críticas de negócio.
  • Realizar análises estatísticas com base em testes de hipótese para apoio à tomada de decisão e validação de modelos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar algoritmos de machine learning e deep learning , garantindo explicabilidade e rastreabilidade dos modelos criados.
  • Disponibilizar modelos em formato de API , garantindo escalabilidade e integração com diferentes sistemas.
  • Trabalhar com bibliotecas e frameworks populares, como scikit-learn , TensorFlow , PyTorch , entre outras, para construção de soluções de aprendizado de máquina.
  • Utilizar Databricks , SQL e Git para manipulação, versionamento e análise de dados em projetos.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das melhores práticas de desenvolvimento em Python, com aderência às principais PEPs e padrões de codificação.
  • Participar de todo o ciclo de vida do modelo: desde a concepção e treinamento até a publicação e monitoramento em produção.


Requisitos:

  • Formação Superior em áreas como Ciência da Computação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia da Produção, Matemática, Física ou Estatística.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Testes de Hipótese , validação de modelos , explicabilidade de modelos e principais algoritmos de machine learning.
  • Experiência prática em modelos de recomendação e detecção de fraudes .
  • Vivência no uso de Python , com profundo entendimento das principais PEPs e bibliotecas voltadas para machine learning e deep learning.
  • Experiência com Databricks , SQL e Git .
  • Histórico comprovado de participação em projetos como cientista de dados, com foco na construção e publicação de modelos anti fraude ou sistemas de recomendação.
  • Experiência na disponibilização de modelos de machine learning em formato API .



O que te oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado

Azure Data Bricks; Azure Data Factory; Azure Data Services

Experience with columnar and table formats (Parquet, Delta, Hudi, Iceberg).

Use of Data Quality tools (Great Expectations, Soda).

Best practices for API security (Cognito, WAF, IAM Policies).

Good communication and teamwork.

Proactivity in problem-solving.

Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver clean, reliable datasets.

Optimize data workflows/pipelines for performance and cost efficiency in a cloud environment.

Implement best practices around data security, governance, and compliance.

Develop CI/CD pipelines for data engineering workflows.

Monitor, troubleshoot, and enhance existing data solutions for reliability and performance.

Document design patterns, best practices, and operational procedures.

title: Complex Investigations Manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 65+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 10,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role

Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for an Intelligence Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on complex investigations (AML, sanctions, and organised fraud).

You'll act as the core investigative expert for the Brazilian market, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and conduct deep-dive analyses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing

  • Conducting in-depth, intelligence-led investigations into high-risk money laundering, sanctions, fraud, and organised crime cases involving customers in Brazil
  • Identifying emerging ML/TF typologies across PIX, credit, retail, and business products, translating findings into actionable insights and control enhancements
  • Ensuring timely and accurate reporting to COAF and supporting MLROs with defensible SAR narratives and documentation aligned with BCB requirements
  • Escalating systemic gaps identified through investigations, raising risk incidents, and coordinating remediation with FinCrime Product and Data teams
  • Contributing to FinCrime governance forums (CRC, ERC, ExCo), providing data-backed updates on investigations, risk trends, and control effectiveness
  • Acting as an interface between CIU, global FIU, compliance assurance, and external regulators during inspections or information requests

What you'll need

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex AML and fraud investigations within a financial institution or fintech, including exposure to layering, scams, synthetic identities, and organised crime
  • A solid understanding of BCB and COAF frameworks, including SAR requirements, sanctions, and fraud-reporting obligations
  • Experience identifying systemic gaps, raising risk incidents, and designing remediation plans across AML and fraud controls
  • Expertise in reading and interpreting transaction data (PIX, credit, card, business), using Looker, SQL, or equivalent tools to detect typologies and outliers
  • The ability to prepare clear, defensible reports and narratives for regulatory filings and internal governance forums
  • To be able to explain complex AML/fraud findings to non-technical audiences, senior management, and regulators

Nice to have

  • The ability to perform deep data exploration using SQL, Python, or visualisation tools (Looker, Power BI) to detect typologies or anomalies
  • Confidence presenting findings, risk summaries, and recommendations to senior management, committees, or regulators
  • An interest in coaching junior investigators and supporting FinCrime capability growth in Brazil
  • Prior exposure to regulatory inspections or audits, including BCB or internal audit follow-ups, with experience presenting control evidence


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.


By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime.

We're looking for an Intelligence Manager to reinforce our first line of defence (1LoD) FinCrime framework in Brazil and focus on complex investigations (AML, sanctions, and organised fraud).

You'll act as the core investigative expert for the Brazilian market, bringing your senior expertise to secure our operations and conduct deep-dive analyses.

Up to shape what’s next in finance? Let’s get in touch.


What you'll be doing

  • Conducting in-depth, intelligence-led investigations into high-risk money laundering, sanctions, fraud, and organised crime cases involving customers in Brazil
  • Identifying emerging ML/TF typologies across PIX, credit, retail, and business products, translating findings into actionable insights and control enhancements
  • Ensuring timely and accurate reporting to COAF and supporting MLROs with defensible SAR narratives and documentation aligned with BCB requirements
  • Escalating systemic gaps identified through investigations, raising risk incidents, and coordinating remediation with FinCrime Product and Data teams
  • Contributing to FinCrime governance forums (CRC, ERC, ExCo), providing data-backed updates on investigations, risk trends, and control effectiveness
  • Acting as an interface between CIU, global FIU, compliance assurance, and external regulators during inspections or information requests

What you'll need

  • 7+ years of experience leading complex AML and fraud investigations within a financial institution or fintech, including exposure to layering, scams, synthetic identities, and organised crime
  • A solid understanding of BCB and COAF frameworks, including SAR requirements, sanctions, and fraud-reporting obligations
  • Experience identifying systemic gaps, raising risk incidents, and designing remediation plans across AML and fraud controls
  • Expertise in reading and interpreting transaction data (PIX, credit, card, business), using Looker, SQL, or equivalent tools to detect typologies and outliers
  • The ability to prepare clear, defensible reports and narratives for regulatory filings and internal governance forums
  • To be able to explain complex AML/fraud findings to non-technical audiences, senior management, and regulators

Nice to have

  • The ability to perform deep data exploration using SQL, Python, or visualisation tools (Looker, Power BI) to detect typologies or anomalies
  • Confidence presenting findings, risk summaries, and recommendations to senior management, committees, or regulators
  • An interest in coaching junior investigators and supporting FinCrime capability growth in Brazil
  • Prior exposure to regulatory inspections or audits, including BCB or internal audit follow-ups, with experience presenting control evidence


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. title: Graphic Designer
description:
Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor – Full-Time)

Candidates must apply with an online portfolio in order to be considered.


WHO YOU ARE

You’re a highly creative, socially fluent designer who knows how to make people stop scrolling. You understand how content performs across platforms like TikTok and Instagram and know how to turn ideas into visuals that feel native, authentic, and viral.

You’re fluent in visual storytelling — from layouts and typography to repurposing video stills or designing carousels that tell a story. You think about content as part of a bigger narrative, not just a single post. You love collaborating with others, working fast, and iterating based on feedback.


WHAT WE NEED

ODDITY is seeking a Graphic Designer (Remote Contractor) to join our Growth Marketing and Organic Social team as we launch a new brand under the ODDITY portfolio.

This role will help define how the brand looks and feels across social media — shaping everything from post design to campaign visuals and creator-led content. You’ll translate ideas into cohesive, scroll-stopping creative that drives engagement, conversation, and brand awareness. We’re looking for someone who’s deeply tuned into social trends, understands the balance of storytelling and aesthetics, and can bring a strategic eye to organic social design.

Note: Our team works EST hours, and candidates should be available during standard business hours.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design a variety of assets for organic and paid social , including carousels, post graphics, stories, and light video edits
  • Help establish the visual identity for a new ODDITY brand , ensuring consistency and cohesion across platforms
  • Partner with marketing and creative teams to interpret briefs and bring ideas to life in visually impactful ways
  • Repurpose and adapt content for different social formats and trends
  • Collaborate closely with copywriters, growth leads, and creators to build assets that feel fresh, social-first, and culturally relevant


YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in graphic design for marketing or social media
  • Proficient in Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator (After Effects or Premiere a plus, but not required)
  • Strong eye for layout, typography, and visual hierarchy
  • Proven ability to design for social performance — balancing brand polish with native, engaging formats
  • Basic familiarity with AI design tools and interest in emerging creative technologies
  • Strong attention to detail and time management
  • Excellent communication skills and openness to collaboration and feedback
  • Impressive work ethic and willingness to work in a fast-paced and high-growth environment
  • Full written and spoken English proficiency


BONUS POINTS

  • Deep understanding of TikTok and Instagram aesthetics and trends
  • Experience supporting brand launches or rebrands


WHO WE ARE

ODDITY is a consumer tech company that builds and scales digital-first brands to disrupt the offline-dominated beauty and wellness industries. Using data science, AI, and tech innovation, we serve over 40 million users through personalized product experiences.

ODDITY owns IL MAKIAGE and SpoiledChild, and is now building its next breakthrough brand — launching soon.


With headquarters in New York City, an R&D center in Tel Aviv, and a biotechnology lab in Boston, ODDITY operates at the intersection of tech, science, and creativity. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and impact-driven — ideal for those who thrive on building from the ground up.

title: Executivo de Vendas | Closer
description:
Sobre o G4 Educação

Somos o G4 Educação, somos A Evolução da Escola de Negócios.

O G4 é o lugar onde as pessoas trabalham duro para fazer do Brasil o país da prosperidade. O lugar que já gerou centenas de milhares de novos empregos por meio de seus alunos e que vai gerar pelo menos 1 milhão até 2030.

Encaramos o empreendedorismo como a maior ferramenta de transformação socioeconômica que existe e é através dela que faremos nossa revolução.

Estamos construindo uma nova geração, a geração que não pede, cria, que não espera, faz, que gera resultados para seus negócios e empregos para o país. A geração que celebra o sucesso das empresas e dos empresários porque entende que o sucesso dos negócios é o sucesso do Brasil.


Missão do Cargo

Estamos à procura de um Executivo de Vendas dinâmico e proativo, com experiência comprovada em negociar com founders, especialmente em vendas consultivas high ticket. Se você possui habilidades avançadas de comunicação e um talento especial para conduzir processos de vendas inbound, esta pode ser a oportunidade ideal para você.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Garantir uma experiência excepcional para os leads desde o primeiro contato até o fechamento da venda;
  • Realizar ligações e entrevistas com leads Inbound;
  • Identificar, qualificar e desenvolver oportunidades de vendas;
  • Realizar diagnósticos e demonstrações/apresentações de propostas comerciais;
  • Fazer follow-ups com oportunidades;
  • Negociar com os clientes e efetivar vendas;
  • Gerenciar o pipeline e forecast de vendas;
  • Adaptar-se facilmente a um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e competitivo, onde a excelência e os resultados são reconhecidos e recompensados diariamente.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Conhecimento prático de CRM, preferencialmente HubSpot;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e colaborativa em um ambiente acelerado;
  • Tem inteligência emocional e está disposto a trabalhar em um ambiente que exige resiliência e aptidão a mudanças rápidas na operação;
  • Orientação para resultados e habilidades sólidas de negociação.


Informações Adicionais

Nós oferecemos:

Benefício flexível de R$ 1000,00 no cartão iFood Benefícios.

Saúde - Assistência Médica da Alice (sem coparticipação).

️Descanso Remunerado de 30 dias após 12 meses.

title: Sr. Business Analyst & Product Design
description:
Role Overview:


The Business Analyst – Product Designer is a key member of the design team, partnering with business stakeholders and solution architects to deliver value-added features for sales, marketing, and billing teams. While the primary focus is on Service Sales CRM solutions, this role also provides exposure to a suite of enterprise applications. The BA transforms stakeholder visions into functional features, documents requirements, and works closely with development teams to bring solutions to life.


On a typical day you will:


  • Assess business processes, system landscapes, and user pain points to recommend technical solutions and workarounds.
  • Facilitate requirements gathering and functional design sessions with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Document detailed functional design specifications (epics, features, user stories).
  • Lead refinement sessions with Scrum teams to review feature designs, estimate effort, and prepare for sprint cycles.
  • Support QA and UAT test planning, execution, and bug triage.
  • Present live product demonstrations and prepare release notes for end users.
  • Assist with sprint planning, stakeholder communications, and retrospectives to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to change management through documentation, training, and stakeholder engagement.


What You Will Need to be Successful:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in business analysis, product design, or related roles, ideally within CRM platforms.
  • Strong background in requirements gathering, process mapping, and translating business needs into technical specifications.
  • Hands-on experience with Agile delivery methods, including writing user stories and partnering with Scrum teams.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional and global stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (Microsoft Dynamics 365 Sales strongly preferred) and exposure to cloud-based solutions, APIs, and system integrations.


Local Benefits or Selling Statement


This role offers the opportunity to work in a global environment, gaining exposure to local and international stakeholders. You will grow both business and technical skillsets while shaping CRM and enterprise applications that drive real impact across unique business streams.


Apply today to join us and build what’s next!.

title: LATAM Business Development Representative
description:
About Prometheus Group

Prometheus Group is a team of self-starters centered on being resourceful, accountable, and results-focused. Career progress is based on merit and not years of service or attaining certifications. Our drive and dedication to creating great products for our global customers are at the heart of all we do! In joining Prometheus, you will become a part of the largest global provider of comprehensive enterprise asset management (EAM) software solutions that support the management life cycle for equipment maintenance and operations.


Job Summary

Do you love the thrill of victory? Are you interested in a path to success? Then the Business Development Representative role at Prometheus Group is your job! Business Development Representatives immediately affect the overall pipeline and growth of our company. With the advanced sales tactics that we institute, you will not only be an integral part of our sales process but also contribute to our overall bottom line. The Business Development Representative role is the backbone of our successful LATAM sales team, and we want you to be a part of that!


At Prometheus Group, we live and breathe off a meritocracy-based promotion system. Promotions are not based on tenure but based on the ability & talent you possess within this role. Business Development Representatives will have opportunities to progress into different paths, such as Account Management or Team Management.


Your role will be to seek new business opportunities by contacting and developing relationships with potential clients, so ambition is a top priority when looking for the perfect candidate. You will use your communication skills to cultivate strong relationships with prospects from the first contact until you qualify the opportunity. Do you think you have what it takes? Submit your resume today!



Responsibilities

  • Maintain high call volume daily (80-100 calls)
  • Develop leads in cold and warm prospect accounts to generate interest in our solutions.
  • Gather prospects' needs and understand their initiatives related to our solutions.
  • Discover new software opportunities by calling targeted prospect accounts
  • Generate a steady flow of qualified opportunities each month
  • Develop and deliver high-level product presentations to new clients.
  • Participate in the development of accounts, prospect profiling, and sales cycles.
  • Collaborate with experienced account managers when prospecting accounts and creating opportunities.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Fluent in Spanish and Portuguese
  • High-energy self-starter who can learn quickly and engage clients
  • 1+ years of cold calling experience preferred
  • Ambition to grow and build a career in sales
  • Ability to resonate with the prospect's situation and detect needs
  • Positive and energetic phone skills
  • Customer-focused, results-driven with excellent interpersonal skills
  • Salesforce experience is a plus


Prometheus Group is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

title: Desenvolvedor .net pleno (experiencia com IA)
description:
Somos a maior multinacional brasileira e estamos entre as 100 maiores empresas de TI do mundo. Estamos presentes em 41 países com mais de 30 mil colaboradores. A Stefanini tem como principal objetivo auxiliar os clientes a encontrar, por meio de soluções personalizadas, a maneira ideal para alcançar seus desafios, impulsionando a inovação digital. E queremos mais!


  • Atuação 100% remoto.


Responsabilidades:

  • Utilizar copilots de IA (como GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot ou similares) para criar, revisar e otimizar código, aumentando a produtividade e a eficiência do desenvolvimento de software.
  • Desenvolver e manter soluções utilizando linguagens de programação C#, entre outras.
  • Trabalhar em plataformas Microsoft (M365, Power Platform, Dynamics, Azure) para desenvolver soluções integradas e inovadoras.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de versionamento de código utilizando Git/GitHub, garantindo organização e rastreabilidade dos projetos.
  • Colaborar na implementação de estratégias de segurança, compliance e governança no uso de IA, assegurando a conformidade com políticas internas e regulamentações externas.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre as tendências de IA aplicada ao desenvolvimento e propor a adoção de novas tecnologias e metodologias.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de copilots de IA, como GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot ou soluções similares.
  • Conhecimento avançado em linguagens de programação como C#;
  • Familiaridade com plataformas Microsoft (M365, Power Platform, Dynamics, Azure).
  • Compreensão sólida de boas práticas de versionamento de código e uso de ferramentas como Git/GitHub.
  • Noções de segurança, compliance e governança relacionadas ao uso de IA em ambientes corporativos.
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe, colaborar em projetos multidisciplinares e compartilhar conhecimento sobre os benefícios da IA no desenvolvimento.


O que te oferecemos:

Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado

Mentoring

title: AI Agent Developer Jr
description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Analista de Automação de IA Jr

Contratação CLT


Estamos em busca de uma pessoa com mão na massa e experiência prática comprovada em ferramentas de automação e integração para atuar na criação de agentes inteligentes e fluxos com IA generativa. Essa vaga é ideal para quem já colocou automações no ar, conhece ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, APIs REST e está em busca de um ambiente onde possa evoluir criando soluções reais com impacto direto no negócio.

Você irá contribuir na construção e evolução de agentes em um time estratégico e conectado com a área de Produtos.


Quais serão suas responsabilidades neste desafio?

  • Mapear processos repetitivos e oportunidades de automação utilizando IA e integrações inteligentes.
  • Criar, configurar e manter agentes operacionais integrados a ferramentas como Microsoft Teams, Jira, Supabase e WhatsApp.
  • Desenvolver automações robustas e reutilizáveis com ferramentas como N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Conectar APIs e Webhooks para promover fluxos dinâmicos entre sistemas.
  • Aplicar IA generativa (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) para automatizar decisões, gerar conteúdo e criar experiências personalizadas.
  • Monitorar o desempenho das automações e propor melhorias contínuas.
  • Colaborar com áreas de negócio para entender dores reais e traduzir em soluções operacionais com IA.
  • Garantir boas práticas de segurança e governança de dados nas integrações.


Qualificações Exigidas:

  • Experiência prévia em automações no ar com pelo menos uma das ferramentas: N8N, Power Automate, Zapier, Make ou similares.
  • Familiaridade com integrações via APIs REST e Webhooks.
  • Noções de bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL (ex: Supabase, Firebase, MongoDB).
  • Conhecimento introdutório ou prático em IA generativa e uso de modelos como ChatGPT.
  • Organização, curiosidade, boa comunicação e autonomia para aprender fazendo.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe e entregar soluções com qualidade, mesmo em contextos de baixa complexidade.


Diferenciais

  • Já ter desenvolvido bots ou agentes internos, mesmo em projetos pessoais ou freelas.
  • Experiência com Microsoft Teams Bot Framework ou WhatsApp Business API.
  • Noções de Machine Learning, fluxos com NLP ou experiências com LLMs.
  • Participação em projetos de transformação digital ou hackathons.
  • Conhecimento em documentação técnica e lógica de versionamento (ex: ReadMe, Notion, Git).

title: Software Developer (Mobile / AI-Enabled Workflow)
description:
Software Developer (Mobile / AI-Enabled Workflow)

We are looking for a talented software developer with strong mobile app development experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working across modern tech stacks, integrating AI into their workflow, and solving complex system-level problems that drive our product forward.

Must-Have Skills
  • Mobile app development experience (iOS preferred, Swift expertise required).
  • Familiarity with CICD pipelines and Git workflows.
  • Strong coding skills in at least two of the following:
  • Python
  • TypeScript
  • Swift
  • Experience building and integrating with REST or gRPC APIs.
  • Ability to solve complex system problems and contribute to key architectural decisions .
  • Strong sense of ownership over your work and outcomes.
Nice-to-Have Skills
  • Comfortable experimenting with and integrating AI tools in development workflows (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot).
  • Exposure to ML/AI engineering concepts , with strong interest in LLMs, embeddings, and agent-based systems .
  • Background in game design or interactive UX development.
  • Experience with Java or Android development (not required, but a plus).
What We’re Looking For
  • Someone who thrives in a fast-moving environment.
  • A developer who doesn’t just write code, but looks for smarter, more efficient ways to ship great products.
  • A team player with a growth mindset, positive attitude, and passion for building high-impact software.

title: System Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Senior System Engineer III to join our Enterprise Monitoring team. In this role, you will be critical to the daily operations, maintenance, and optimization of our observability platforms—Splunk, DynaTrace, and NewRelic —and will also support day-to-day ticketing and incident response workflows. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver with a passion for automation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.


Responsibilities:

  • Own the daily health, performance, and availability of enterprise monitoring tools (Splunk, DynaTrace, NewRelic).
  • Perform routine maintenance, upgrades, and configuration tuning to ensure optimal system performance.
  • Triage and resolve monitoring-related incidents and service tickets in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and DevOps teams to integrate monitoring solutions and improve visibility.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and reports to support operational and business needs.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and support incident response efforts.
  • Document operational procedures, runbooks, and knowledge base articles.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities to reduce manual effort and improve reliability.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in systems engineering or enterprise monitoring roles.
  • Hands-on experience with Splunk, DynaTrace, and NewRelic in production environments.
  • Strong understanding of IT operations, incident management, and ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira).
  • Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Bash) for automation and tool integration.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerized environments (Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and a bias for action in high-pressure situations.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; Portuguese is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience working in a global or distributed team.
  • Knowledge of ITIL practices and observability maturity models.
  • Certifications in Splunk, DynaTrace, or NewRelic are a plus.
